messages:
anya (CS): quick summary from todays onboarding syncs (4 customers): recurring asks = per-route spend export, trial extension button, clearer sample prompts for embeddings, and SSO provisioning notes. dropping raw notes + csv: https://notion.redwood/cs/onboard-signals-1749
signal-bot: artefact uploaded: onboard-signals-1749.csv (uploaded by anya)
tom (PM): thanks. callout: Brightline sounded most urgent on billing visibility  CFO needs breakdown by feature. score this as renewal risk if we can't show something next bill.
kevin (Eng): per-route export: backend has per-request attribution already; we can expose a csv endpoint. estimate 3 dev-days + 1 QA day.
priya (Enablement): can we do a short "how to read your bill" webinar + one-pager in parallel? helps buys time for eng. i can run next Tue.
nate (Product): +1 to webinar. also propose a temporary workaround: add a button in console to export last 30 days invoice with route labels. low effort?
kevin (Eng): console button is doable if we reuse existing csv pipeline. depends on auth scope; estimate 1 dev-day.
tom (PM): priority suggestion: 1) csv export/button (fast win), 2) trial extension self-serve (reduces renew risk), 3) sample prompts & onboarding snippets (enablement).
anya (CS): noted. customer verbatim for one-pager:
- "We can't justify the feature spend without per-feature buckets."
- "We hit SSO roadblocks on Day 2  took 3 days to test SCIM mappings."
- "Embeddings examples were helpful but we'd like 3 industry-specific prompt templates."
priya (Enablement): will draft webinar slides + 1-pager. dropping draft link in channel when ready.
kevin (Eng): small flag: trial extension requires billing flow changes (secure token). need product sign-off on policy (max days, auto-approvals).
tom (PM): i'll draft policy options and tag finance/legal.
anya (CS): also capture: onboarding checklist gaps -> customers missed the "test ingest" step. suggest a checkbox in console and a 15m guided tour.
priya (Enablement): guided tour is straightfoward using our tour framework. estimate 2 days to author + 1 day to QA.
signal-bot: reminder created: onboard-triage tomorrow 2024-06-01T17:00:00Z
deploy-bot: staged deploy for csv-export feature branch queued (PR #4821)
kevin (Eng): will open tech task for csv export and console button, assign to @kevin. target spike by Fri.
tom (PM): thanks everyone. action items: kevin tech spike, priya webinar draft, tom policy draft, anya to collect customer quotes + send exec one-pager.
anya (CS): will assemble one-pager now and ping for reviews. :thumbsup:
